# Agent testing (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Testing the agents: golden runs against known right answers, and the Verifier, measured against people's judgement.

## Files

- `agent-testing-routes.ts`: Agent testing API: the golden dataset and its runs, the Verifier's settings, labelled examples and calibration, and the Verifier check on one card.
- `golden.ts`: Agent testing: a golden dataset of use cases with known right answers, a runner that puts an agent through all of them and scores what it drafts, and calibration of the Verifier against claims people labelled good or bad.
- `verifier.ts`: The Verifier: an advisory check (LLM-as-a-judge) on whether each item of a draft is backed by the knowledge-base passages it cites.
